description: Build a consensus from pre-aligned reads ('-'/'.' skipped; 'N' is a residue and is counted) by column-wise plurality (Biopython dumb_consensus rule; default threshold 0.5, ambiguous 'N', case-insensitive). Ties and sub-threshold columns emit the ambiguous symbol.

threshold.description: Fraction of non-gap residues the most common residue must exceed or equal (Biopython dumb_consensus threshold). Default 0.5; NaN rejected.

ambiguous.description: Single character emitted for ties / sub-threshold columns. Default 'N'.

requireMultiple.description: Biopython require_multiple: a column with a single residue emits the ambiguous symbol. Default false.

ignoreCase.description: Fold case before voting (EMBOSS reader). false = exact comparison as Biopython. Default true.

consensus.description: The consensus sequence (length equals the longest read).

errors.message: All aligned reads must have the same length
